query:
UPDATE tagging_services
               SET config = jsonb_set(config, '{rules}', (
                       SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(elem ORDER BY ord), '[]'::jsonb)
                       FROM jsonb_array_elements(config->'rules') WITH ORDINALITY AS t(elem, ord)
                       WHERE elem->>'id' <> $3::text
                   )),
                   updated_at = now() AT TIME ZONE 'utc'
               WHERE id = $1 AND owner_id = $2 AND service_type = 'rule'::service_type
                 AND EXISTS (
                   SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements(config->'rules') e
                   WHERE e->>'id' = $3::text)
